* feat(docs): themes-and-color-studio runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.t3k)

The 1,250-line app.ts is split by section into files the card shows as
tabs (tour, look, values, themes, transposition, contrast) behind main.ts.
Recording to EXPORT_* needs node/save, so it lives in node.ts, which
npm run themes-and-color-studio runs and the card never reaches. The
tour prints byte-identical to before (EXPORT_TEXT diff).

The card's terminal keeps no scrollback, so card.json gives it the rows
to hold the whole tour, and the width test now also holds the height.

* fix(docs): review — stale entry/fit comments, section dividers (rich-demos-k78j.t3k)
